ideas.title: Minnesota's Efforts to Combat Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate Minnesota's efforts to prevent Medicaid fraud, including the inspection of providers and disenrollment of unresponsive ones.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
How effective are Minnesota's efforts to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it shows the state's efforts to tackle healthcare fraud and protect Medicaid funds. It could also lead to a deeper investigation into the Medicaid system and potential vulnerabilities.
